requirement.statement: The system SHALL let humans create or edit canonical AI workflows using ordinary language through TUI and CLI, using Eidolon actors and component-backed native tools without external agent CLIs.

case.given: A user describes a workflow in ordinary language during an Eidolon conversation
case.when: The AI kernel routes the request
case.then: An Eidolon authoring actor SHALL select the form, generate or edit canonical XNL, run a bounded proof/repair loop and publish through WorkflowComponent

case.given: A user invokes `eidolon workflow create` or `edit` with a natural-language instruction
case.then: The command SHALL use the in-process Eidolon runtime and the same WorkflowAuthor capability, without invoking an external AI CLI

case.given: The authoring actor needs resource facts or mutations
case.when: It inspects the native tool registry
case.then: Component-backed workspace read/tree/search/diff/validate/write/delete primitives SHALL be model-visible
